summary: Verified per-account grouping of the assets EntityManager on /portfolio for CLIENT user. All 6 scenarios in the review request passed end-to-end.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (Emergent framework instrumentation adds <span> wrapper around institution text inside <option>). Non-blocking; also flagged in iter_28 and iter_29 for other option-based selects.

critical_code_review_comments: EntityManager.jsx L106-114 assetGroups memo correctly filters accounts by client id (or all when no cid), builds one group per account with rows filtered by account_id, and pushes an 'assets-group-none' 口座未設定 bucket for orphaned rows (no account_id, or account_id not in current accounts list). Good.

L195-207 grouped tbody is only rendered when entity==='assets' via a ternary; other entities still fall through to plain rows.map(renderRow). Non-assets entities (liabilities, transactions) confirmed to render zero 'assets-group-*' testids. Good.

L105 openNewAcct correctly seeds form with both client_id (when cid) and account_id (when aid). For 'none' group aid is empty string which falls through the `aid ?` check so account_id is NOT set — correct behaviour for unassigned.

L190 loading guard: when entity==='assets' AND rows is empty, the Empty state is intentionally skipped so group headers can still be displayed (allowing per-account '＋ 追加' even when the client has zero assets). Nice UX detail.

L236 there is a duplicate hidden <input type=file data-testid=`${entity}-import-input-global`>; the same input is also declared at L183. Two hidden inputs referring to the SAME fileRef. Harmless but redundant — main agent should remove one.
seed_data_creation: Created asset id 180c6e46-b4bf-41d4-a9f5-fb05dbb2e47c (name TEST_GROUP_ASSET, then edited to TEST_GROUP_ASSET_EDITED) under bitFlyer(JPY) account, then deleted via assets-delete for cleanup. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: As client@finora.co.jp on /portfolio, the assets EntityManager rendered 5 group headers with correct testids and counts: assets-group-2e0a2f92... (bitFlyer JPY, 1), assets-group-755d270e... (Interactive Brokers USD, 4), assets-group-371118a8... (SBI証券 JPY, 4), assets-group-f7e8656b... (三菱UFJ銀行 JPY, 1), assets-group-none (口座未設定, 2). Each header showed a '＋ 新規登録' button with data-testid assets-add-to-<key>. Clicking assets-add-to-2e0a2f92... opened assets-form-dialog with field-account_id pre-selected to the correct id. Saved a new asset (asset_class=日本株, name=TEST_GROUP_ASSET) — DOM order confirmed the new row appeared BETWEEN the bitFlyer group header and the next group header. Edit via assets-edit-<id> opened dialog with correct name, edit persisted. Delete via assets-delete-<id>+confirm-delete-ok removed it. Import: assets-import-btn opens asset-import-dialog with asset-import-account <select>. Regression: on /liabilities and /transactions, zero elements with testid prefix 'assets-group-' were found; entity-liabilities and entity-transactions render normally.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature works exactly as specified.
